infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Orbit Chat uses the camera only when you start a video call.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Orbit Chat uses the microphone for audio calls, video calls, and voice messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Orbit Chat uses photo access only when you choose an image to send or set as an avatar.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Orbit Chat may save exported chat files or media when you choose to save them.
